purpose: Discard the failed prose/scene implementation, rebuild the novel from the minimal story kernel, and produce a small representative prose pilot for actual human approval before any new full manuscript is drafted.
forbidden_inputs: Phase360 V2 manuscript prose during architecture/pilot authoring
Phase360 repair reports/notes as prose guidance
Phase361 evaluator praise or PASS labels as preservation requirements
source-book prose or recognizable author style
architecture_requirements: Every retained character/faction must have a distinct dramatic and emotional job; merge or delete redundant board-state actors.
The middle must not be structured as a parade of new entrants explaining motives and shifting the tactical board.
After masking names/props/lore, major scenes must use materially different dramatic engines.

Dialogue must arise from immediate desire, relationship asymmetry, current physical behavior, withheld information, interruption and misreading; do not use repeated short Q&A/dry-retort cadence as the default prose engine.
The first major sequence must create actual desire-to-continue before large-scale faction/system exposition.
Suspense must change a cared-about prediction, trust relation or costly decision.
Climax must grow through narrowing options, personal cost and irreversible choice rather than adding more combatants/events.
Do not preserve a scene just because a prior AI audit called it strong.

pilot_sections: P1 opening + ordinary human interaction + hook
P3 suspense/reveal scene demonstrating answer-specific desire

pilot_rules: Pilot prose must be written from the abstract architecture, not line-edited from the old manuscript.
Do not intentionally mimic Jin Yong, Xiao Ding, Nanpai Sanshu, or any living/dead author's recognizable prose style.
Do not explain to the human which old defect each sample is trying to fix before they read it.
Human reaction to the prose surface controls whether the approach can expand to a full manuscript.
next_after_completion: Actual human reads the four pilot samples without old-repair framing. If prose/scene experience is accepted, coordinator may authorize a full blank-page manuscript draft. If rejected, discard/redesign the pilot approach before any full draft.
